title: Reversing an append swaps and reverses the operands
statement: Reversing the concatenation of two lists a and b equals concatenating the reverse of b with the reverse of a (in that order).

formal.statement: theorem List.reverse_append : ((x0 : Sort (1)) -> ((x1 : List.{0} x0) -> ((x2 : List.{0} x0) -> Eq.{1} (List.{0} x0) (List.reverse x0 (List.append x0 x1 x2)) (List.append x0 (List.reverse x0 x2) (List.reverse x0 x1)))))

evidence.supports: List.reverse_append is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example list_theorem_inventory -- List.reverse_append 2>/dev/null | grep -Fc '((x0 : Sort (1)) -> ((x1 : List.{0} x0) -> ((x2 : List.{0} x0) -> Eq.{1} (List.{0} x0) (List.reverse x0 (List.append x0 x1 x2)) (List.append x0 (List.reverse x0 x2) (List.reverse x0 x1)))))')" -ge 1
